build_attempts.error: PyTorch reported that the MPS backend requires macOS 13.0+ in the managed shell.

examples: prompt 23: household appliance versus transparent battery box
prompt 549: giraffes versus pyramids and camel riders

decision: Do not score any candidate detector on v1. Select unused prompts by text-to-real matchability and rebuild.
boundary: The rejection is based only on candidate-independent data QA and occurred before PE, DINO, blend or v6 scores were computed on this gate.
